title: fastatacular: A pure-Python library for reading and writing FASTA sequence files
description: fastatacular is a pure-Python library for reading and writing FASTA sequence files. It parses standard FASTA records into structured SequenceEntry objects and supports optional parsing of UniProt-style description keys (OS=, OX=, GN=, PE=, SV=) and pipe-delimited identifiers such as sp|P12345|EX_HUMAN and gi|12345|ref|NP_000001.1|. It is the plain-FASTA companion to pefftacular, sharing the same read/write API shape, and is intended for proteomics and genomics pipelines that need lightweight, dependency-free FASTA parsing. It requires Python 3.12 or later.
